CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MiesieczneOkresyDlaKonta ( @CDN_PoczatekOO int, @CDN_KoniecOO int, @CDN_Filtr varchar(255) ) AS
DECLARE @DT_OOOD datetime DECLARE @DT_OODo datetime DECLARE @DT_OD datetime DECLARE @DT_Do datetime DECLARE @DT_Wrk datetime SET @DT_OOOD = DATEADD(DAY,@CDN_PoczatekOO,convert(datetime,'1800-12-28',120)) SET @DT_OODO = DATEADD(DAY,@CDN_KoniecOO,convert(datetime,'1800-12-28',120)) SET @DT_Wrk = @DT_OOOD Create Table #Tmp ( Konto varchar(255) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Rok int, Miesiac int, DataOd int, DataDo int )
WHILE datediff(month,@DT_Wrk,@DT_OODO)>=0 BEGIN select @DT_OD=convert(datetime,@DT_Wrk,120) select @DT_Wrk=dateadd(month,1,convert(datetime,@DT_Wrk,120)) select @DT_DO=dateadd(day,-1,convert(datetime,@DT_Wrk,120)) insert into #Tmp select '',0,0,DATEDIFF(day,convert(datetime,'1800-12-28',120),@DT_OD), DATEDIFF(day,convert(datetime,'1800-12-28',120),@DT_Do) END
DECLARE @S1 varchar (512)
SET @S1 = 'UPDATE #Tmp SET Konto = KKS_Konto, Rok=KKS_Rok, Miesiac=KKS_Miesiac FROM CDN.Konta Konta where ' + @CDN_Filtr EXEC (@S1);
SELECT * FROM #Tmp
DROP table #Tmp
